- Implementation changes ONLY to lifecycle.py and test_lifecycle.py.
- Do NOT modify requirements.md or backlog.md (or README.md, or any CEO/decision file).

{
  "native": "<obsolete_assertion|implementation_defect>",
  "external": "<obsolete_assertion|implementation_defect>",
  "evidence": {
    "native": { ... your supporting evidence ... },
    "external": { ... your supporting evidence ... }
  }
}
The values of "native" and "external" at top level must be exactly one of the two literal strings. Put reasoning, quoted contract text, before/after behavior, and file:line references inside the evidence object only.
3. Create improvements.md containing any UNRELATED improvement suggestions you noticed (things outside this repair's scope). Keep them as suggestions only — do not implement them.

VERIFY before reporting:
- Run: python3 -m unittest test_lifecycle -v   (must pass, both tests)
- Run: python3 -m json.tool diagnosis.json     (must parse)
Note: the shell runs with errexit and pipefail.

Report back: what you changed in each file, the two classifications and why, and the verbatim test output.
